name: Fernando de Noronha
blurb: Fernando de Noronha has appeared in travel conversation only in the last few weeks, from a base of almost nothing. Early posts are enthusiastic but the sample is still small.

positive: Quieter than the better-known spots nearby
Food repeatedly singled out as a highlight
Easy to get around without a car
negative: Some report crowding at peak times

quotes.text: Getting harder to find a decent room under budget this year.
Spent a week here working remotely, wifi was fine everywhere.
Much quieter than I expected — barely anyone on the beach at sunset.
